description: LexRegPulse's daily banking regulatory brief, published every weekday and weekend morning at 6:45 AM ET. Sections: the lead story with its bank-side transmission, regulatory developments (OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, CFPB, FinCEN, OFAC, SEC, CFTC, NCUA and the states), industry signals (market and industry context: rates, deals, funding, fintech), political and legislative items, what's coming (comment windows, effective dates) and what it means. Every figure is traced to a source and every edition is QA-scored before it sends. Returns markdown with the canonical URL; each bullet is addressable on the web page as #b-1, #b-2, …

date.description: Optional edition date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the most recent edition.

name: get_daily_briefing
